passages.title: Ordering Guidelines for New Staff
lines: This booklet is for your initial training. It defines the basic steps for placing an order and enables new staff to work on their own.
1. Finding the client: Find the client's code in the database before you start, and fill in every line of the form. Incomplete orders are not sent. They stay in the system.
2. Large orders: Show any order of ten boxes or more to Ms. Carter first.
3. Email: Clients expect a prompt reply. Answer every email within one working day.
4. Phone: Appropriate behavior on the phone is important. Say the company name first, and then your own name. If you don't know the answer, say that you will call back.
5. Every Friday: Archive all finished orders, and check regularly for old orders that were never sent.
A reminder: Never delete an order. If you are not sure, ask your mentor.
Please read this booklet thoroughly before your first week ends.

scene.zh: 好，我自己做了一筆。現在送出嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's go over the order once more before you send it.
scene.zh: 送出前我們再把這筆訂單看過一次吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good thing we checked. I typed the wrong code!
scene.zh: 還好有檢查，我打錯代碼了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: How's it going? And this came for you, Leo. It's about a seminar.
scene.zh: 進行得怎樣？喔，Leo，這是給你的，是一場研討會的資料。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think this seminar would be really useful for you.
scene.zh: 我覺得這個研討會對你會很有幫助。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks! I'd love to go.
scene.zh: 謝謝！我很想去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, how did he do on his first day?
scene.zh: 那他第一天表現得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: He's picking things up faster than I expected.
scene.zh: 他學得比我想的還快。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great to hear. You can tell he's motivated. Welcome to the team, Leo!
scene.zh: 太好了，看得出來他很有幹勁。Leo，歡迎加入我們！
